title: Machine learning and experiments nominate carbonic anhydrase 4 in methotrexate fibrosis
summary: An ensemble of 112 machine-learning classifiers with SHAP ranking across six GEO fibrosis cohorts, intersected with predicted methotrexate targets, ranked carbonic anhydrase 4 (CA4) first (SHAP 0.120; diagnostic AUC 0.879). Methotrexate bound recombinant CA4 by SPR (KD 6.25 uM); CA4 fell and TLR4 rose in methotrexate-treated mice, and CA4 overexpression suppressed EMT and TLR4-NF-kB/IRF3 signalling in BEAS-2B cells. Machine learning is one upstream step, binding is micromolar and in vitro, in vivo CA4 evidence is correlational and TLR4 causal necessity was untested.
ai_technology: Ensemble of 112 machine-learning classifiers with SHAP ranking across six GEO fibrosis cohorts to nominate CA4
organization: Xiangyang Hospital affiliated to Hubei University of Chinese Medicine

evidence.tested: SPR binding, a methotrexate mouse model and BEAS-2B overexpression and rescue experiments following machine-learning target nomination.
evidence.unknown: Causal necessity of TLR4, direct binding in vivo and clinical relevance; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Ensemble classifiers and SHAP ranked fibrosis-related genes to nominate CA4 for experimental follow-up.
